blind.description: A stylized wooden barrel filled with arrows. The barrel is constructed from warm brown/orange wooden staves bound by two dark iron hoops with visible round rivets. Inside, the barrel is packed tightly with arrows, showing their upright red and cream-coloured fletched ends. The asset features clean, hand-painted stylized textures with solid, well-defined geometry.
blind.from_above: A circular wooden rim bounded by metal hoop studs, filled with a dense, textured cluster of red and cream arrow feathers resembling a spiky flower head or brush.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (just under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.8 feet in diameter.
